user.title: Thaw period in Québec
user.description: Choose the thaw zones to follow (périodes de dégel, Transports Québec). When your Home Assistant home location is in a zone, that zone is preselected. The *Thaw season* sensor turns on some days before the first period starts and stays on until some days after the last one ends: use it to show a card only around the thaw.

data_description.days_before: The Thaw season sensor turns on this many days before a period starts.
data_description.days_after: It stays on this many days after the period ends.
